capabilities: Convert images to Braille or ASCII art
Replace image embeds across the vault
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin store (pending review); manual install or BRAT works now. All conversion runs locally with no network, telemetry, or runtime dependencies.
motivation: Images stuck inside notes are a liability; this is step one toward lossless-enough PDF/EPUB to Markdown conversion where images never block portability.
problem: Embedded images bloat sync, break on export, are invisible to full-text search, and can vanish when linked files move or attachments folders are cleaned.
summary: Image-to-text converter that renders PNG/JPG/GIF/BMP/WebP images as colored Braille or ASCII Unicode art stored as plain text in notes.
